title: Thai wording for the three rows that D-RCV-60 adds to the glossary
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench Acceptance Criteria Glossary v1.xlsx
description: Version 1 gives a Thai cell for every keyword, sentence frame and code prefix. The three rows this work package adds (the contract mock Given, the acceptance criteria origin tag and the -ITG test case suffix) have no Thai wording in any source document, so each of their Thai cells carries the placeholder of Template and Rules section R9.
evidence: The source workbook gives Thai for all 4 keyword rows, all 55 sentence frame rows and all 15 code prefix rows; no source document gives Thai for 'contract fake', 'origin tag' or '-ITG'.
proposed: Add the Thai wording once it is confirmed; until then the English cell is the authoritative one and the placeholder tells the reader that the wording is outstanding.

title: Origin tag where one legacy criterion is carried by several new stories
source: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Story Template and Rules v1.md (section R7.2 section 7); _work/msr/plan/split_plan.json (legacy)
description: A legacy story that is split repeats its criteria in more than one new story, because one legacy story becomes several service stories. The rule fixes one tag form, '(legacy RWB-...-nnn ACn)', and does not say whether the repeated criterion keeps that same tag in every story that carries it or whether the tag is qualified by the service.
evidence: split_plan.json: RWB-E1-001 becomes RWB-P1-E1001-APP, RWB-P7-E1001-APP, RWB-P4-E1001-APP, RWB-P8-E1001-APP and RWB-ITG-E1001-ITG. Section R7.2 section 7 gives the tag form with no qualifier.
proposed: Keep the tag unqualified: it names the legacy story and the criterion number only and is repeated word for word wherever the criterion appears; the story key already carries the service.

title: Name, version and location of a contract fake
source: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Story Template and Rules v1.md (section R5.4 class C, section R5.5 DP-11, section R7.2 section 12.8)
description: A story with a class C dependency builds against the other service's published contract and its fake, and section 12.8 of the story has to list that fake. No source document gives the fake a name, a version scheme or a place to publish it, so a Given line can only say 'the <service> contract fake'.
evidence: Section R5.5 DP-11 reads 'REST contract with mock; one hop; 2 s timeout'; section R7.2 section 12.8 names the table 'Contract fakes' but not the artefact; the Arch v5 text extract and the Service Contract Catalog v1 carry contracts, not fakes.
proposed: Publish the fake with the contract it fakes, as '<service> contract fake' at the contract's version, and let the Given line name that artefact.

title: Level and register place of an -ITG copy of a test case
source: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Story Template and Rules v1.md (section R7.2 section 16)
description: The rule says that an ITG copy of a test case ends in -ITG. It does not say which Level the copy takes (Integration or End to end), whether the plain copy stays in section 16, or whether the copy is a separate row in the Test Cases master and the RTM.
evidence: Section R7.2 section 16 reads 'TC ID, Covers, Level (Unit, Component, Contract, Integration, End to end, NFR), Data. ITG copies of a TC end in -ITG.' Only the suffix is specified.
proposed: Keep the plain ID on the unit, component and contract copy; add the -ITG copy as a separate row at Level Integration or End to end and carry it into the Test Cases master and the RTM as its own ID.
